answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 32 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The voyage debit happens at intake, lagoon totals the burned amount, and vine anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm hence forfeits the burn once for each alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The bill scales 32 fold, not the vote. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
